name: Griffith University
summary: Queensland university across Brisbane and the Gold Coast, with three trimesters a year; international students apply all year round.

ib.text: Griffith welcomes the IB Diploma; each degree lists a minimum ATAR or IB score on its Degree Finder page, plus any portfolio, interview or audition.

noDeadline: Applications accepted all year round; apply early for visa time

apply.via: Griffith online or agent (QTAC for Australian IB)

notes: International students at an Australian high school apply through QTAC; students elsewhere apply online to Griffith or through an agent.
Griffith recommends applying by mid-November for a Trimester 1 start, mid-April for Trimester 2 and mid-July for Trimester 3, so the visa can be processed; some programs have specific deadlines.
Trimester 1 2027 classes start on 1 March 2027, after orientation week.

sources.title: Griffith: International applications, trimester dates and recommended apply-by
